prioritized_experiments.minimal_test: On verified membrane-active cases and same-assay controls, test whether experimentally membrane-related descriptors/state changes add information beyond composition and frozen sequence scores. Keep original main dataset and labels unchanged.
prioritized_experiments.novelty_potential: medium-high if state-dependent representation is validated, low if only generic hydrophobic features are appended
prioritized_experiments.pilot_time_estimate: 1-2 weeks after assay data can be recovered
prioritized_experiments.compute: local annotation/statistics first; small GPU pilot only after evidence; no full-dataset MD first
prioritized_experiments.stop_rule: If controlled differences disappear or endpoint/chemistry cannot be aligned, do not add a branch.

prioritized_experiments.hypothesis: Active molecular assembly: monomer versus heterodimer/cooperative membrane action
prioritized_experiments.minimal_test: Recover measured biological entity and partner/state annotations; compare exact assay-backed complexes versus monomers before considering complex-aware inputs. Unknown assembly remains unknown.
prioritized_experiments.novelty_potential: medium-high biological motivation; training data may be scarce
prioritized_experiments.pilot_time_estimate: 1-2 weeks for a small evidence panel; broader work longer
prioritized_experiments.compute: local evidence audit; complex structure inference/MD deferred
prioritized_experiments.stop_rule: If activity of the isolated input chain is not known, do not call it a proven hard positive or increase its weight.

prioritized_experiments.hypothesis: Explicit chemical state: terminal modifications and actual disulfide/redox state
prioritized_experiments.minimal_test: Verify tested terminal forms and linkage chemistry; audit whether retained model input distinguishes them. Same sequence with unknown state cannot be assigned a made-up state.
prioritized_experiments.novelty_potential: medium if chemical-state conditioning has new evidence; ordinary feature concatenation alone low
prioritized_experiments.pilot_time_estimate: 3-7 days for case-level provenance, 1-2 weeks for a controlled pilot
prioritized_experiments.stop_rule: Do not repeat prior failed SoftCys topology as a new idea; no Cys-count-derived gold connectivity.

prioritized_experiments.hypothesis: Within-mechanism, within-family mutation or matched-pair constraints
prioritized_experiments.minimal_test: Use reliable same-assay mutants or matched pairs to test direction of host-cell effects while controlling family/composition; auxiliary supervision can be considered without replacing original main benchmark.
prioritized_experiments.novelty_potential: depends on biologically justified constraints; contrastive loss alone is established
prioritized_experiments.pilot_time_estimate: 1-3 weeks depending on original assay/condition recovery
prioritized_experiments.compute: local analysis then small model pilot
prioritized_experiments.stop_rule: Split by family/study; do not train on historical Test1/Test2 error labels or force all toxic effects into one membrane mechanism.

weighting_policy_for_next_pilot.baseline: ordinary hard-example weighting is a comparator, not biological novelty
weighting_policy_for_next_pilot.eligible_for_increased_weight: only assay/entity-supported hard examples identified inside each training partition
weighting_policy_for_next_pilot.uncertain_or_conflicting: no automatic weight increase; investigate first
weighting_policy_for_next_pilot.evaluation: new nested base predictions required for correction/routing validation; archived OOF used here is descriptive only
